beats.vo: [Inter] sit twentieth in Europe. [Rotterdam] has stopped being a free hit.
The club's own table puts [Inter] twentieth of thirty-six. The top twenty-four go through.
Twentieth is survivable. It is not a plan. [Rotterdam] decides which half they end up in.
[Tuttosport] says [Pavard] trained Sunday, and a stomach bug left [Thuram] the only attacker at full fitness.
[Feyenoord] away Tuesday, three in the afternoon Eastern, Paramount Plus.
